isolated Git worktrees, persistent journaling, and multi-tier rate limit mitigation. 4: 5: --- 6: 7: ## The Core Concept 8: 9: Codex should not be responsible for staying alive 24/7. 10: 11: Instead of running a single fragile agent session that dies when SSH drops, hits context exhaustion, or halts on rate limits: 12: - **`systemd`** supervises the worker daemon. 13: - **The worker daemon** launches bounded, disposable `codex exec` tasks. 14: - **Isolated Git worktrees** ensure your primary repository checkouts are never polluted. 15: - **`CLIProxyAPI` + Worker Backoff** protects quota and automatically cools down exhausted accounts. 16: - **Live Terminal Attachment**: Tasks run inside persistent `tmux` sessions so you can attach directly to the live agent TUI at any time with `task attach`. 17: 18: ```text 19: systemd 20: ├── cliproxyapi.service (:8317) ──> rotates model keys, handles quotas/cooldowns 21: │ 22: └── codex-worker.service 23: ├── scans ~/srv-codex/tasks/ 24: ├── claims pending task (.claimed) 25: ├── creates isolated git worktree & branch in ~/srv-codex/worktrees/ 26: ├── runs bounded 'codex exec' with safety and timeouts inside tmux (codex-live) 27: ├── tests, reviews, implements minimal fixes 28: ├── commits changes 29: ├── journals findings into history.jsonl 30: ├── handles 429/quota backoff gracefully without hammering 31: └── moves to next task 32: ``` 33: 34: --- 35: 36: ## Features 37: 38: - **Continuous 24/7 Operation**: Survives SSH disconnects, terminal closures, reboots, and network resets. 39: - **Branch & Worktree Isolation**: Agents work strictly on disposable branches (`agent/task-...`) inside isolated worktrees. Main/master remains pristine. 40: - **Live Observation (`task attach`)**: Watch the agent think, run tools, and execute commands in full color in real time. Detach anytime with `Ctrl-b d`. 41: - **Session Resumption (`task resume`)**: Step into the interactive Codex TUI with the full session loaded after a run finishes. 42: - **Mistake Memory**: Records failed attempts in `failures.jsonl` and injects past failure notes into subsequent task prompts so the agent never repeats dead ends. 43: -
